CI vs CD

CI integrates changes with automated checks; continuous delivery keeps releases deployable;
continuous deployment automatically releases qualifying changes.
CI එJකන් changes නිතර integrate කර build/test කරනවා. Continuous delivery එJක් release
කරන්න සූදානම් artifact තිJයනවා. Continuous deployment එJක් passing changes automatic
A PR passes tests, staging is deployed, then production requires approval in delivery.

npm ci

# Deployment is a separate gated step
Expected result: If all configured scripts pass, a release artifact is ready.
Is continuous delivery the same as continuous deployment?
No. Delivery can retain a manual production approval; deployment automates it.
Remember: CI checks; CD delivers or deploys.
Practice: Design a pipeline with manual production approval.
